description: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited builds financial products and solutions to manage the business expenses of corporates, small and medium-sized enterprises, and startups through automated workflows. The company operates Propel, a corporate software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for channel rewards and incentives, employee rewards, and recognition; and Save, a SaaS-based platform and a mobile application to offer an expense management solution for business spend management, facilitating digitized employee reimbursements and tax benefits. The company also offers additional solutions, including Zatix for AI-based spend analytics, ZIP for international payments, fleet spend management, prepaid and credit card issuance, and Smart EPP for employee purchase programmes. In addition, it operates Zoyer, an integrated data-driven SaaS-based business spend management platform with embedded automated finance capabilities in core invoices to pay workflows. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India.
